401 Unauthorized for transcription with invalid API key

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"file":"audio.mp3","model":"whisper-1"}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.transcribe(request).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
